summary: Adds a retry helper to the HTTP client and uses it in the sync job.

changes.summary: New retry helper with exponential backoff.

findings.title: Retry loop never stops when maxAttempts is 0
findings.body: The loop condition uses `attempt !== maxAttempts`, so a value of 0 never matches after the first increment.
findings.failure_scenario: retry(fn, { maxAttempts: 0 }) with a failing fn loops forever.
